QuestInfo.name: Arwen's Paint 1
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1032100##k in Ellinia is in dire need of help.
QuestInfo.1:
#bArwen#k was assigned to draw a mural for the Ellinia Magic School Festival, but she can't finish her mural, because she has run out of yellow and green paint. Find #b20 #t4000007#s#k and #b20 #t4000013#s#k, which can be used to make paint.

#i4000007##t4000007# #b#c4000007##k/20
#i4000013##t4000013# #b#c4000013##k/20
QuestInfo.2: You brought the #t4000007#s and #t4000013#s for Arwen. They're such odd ingredients for paint...

0.0: I really don't want to ask a human for help, but you're the only one who can help me, and it's really urgent! Will you please help me?

yes.0: There is going to be a festival at the Magic School, and I'm in charge of the mural. I'll need to use my #bSpecial Paint#k to draw the mural, since Regular Paint runs too easily.
yes.1: Unfortunately, I'm all out of yellow and green paint. I really need them to complete this mural, and time is running out! I need to complete the picture before the other paint dries...
yes.2: I need #b#t4000007#s#k and #b#t4000013#s#k. I'll need #b20#k of each to make enough paint. #t4000007#s and #t4000013#s can be found in the #bNorth Forest#k.

no.0: I guess I shouldn't have expected anything from a human.

1.0: You've brought all the ingredients! Please give them to me, so that I can make my paint.
1.1: Thank you, I can make my paint now. Please take this. It should help you in your adventure.

yes.0: I'll have to excuse myself so that I can go make the paint. Thank you...

item.0: Don't you have the #b#t4000007#s#k and the #b#t4000013#s#k yet? I really need to finish the picture before the paint dries...
